the-story.text: A reviewer wants each requirement of issue three hundred tied to the model statement it rests on, the code that carries it, and the kind of evidence that will establish it, so that proved claims, development-node claims and claims that wait for the public network stay apart. No Lean, statement, corpus, validator or conformance ledger file changes in this work.

the-collateral-correction-with-its-evide.text: Earlier notes said folds and updates put the wallet's largest output up as collateral with no return. The builder's balancer fills the total collateral and the return in cases. It refuses an input that cannot cover the required total, and when what remains is zero or under the minimum output it takes the whole input as the collateral and states no return; otherwise it states one and a half times the fee and returns the rest. Twelve bodies from one development run show the ordinary case for the folds, updates and boot, and that the two bookings name a collateral input but state neither field. The other two cases are read from the source. The measured booking refuses the no-return case, so it never collateralises a whole funding output.
Whether the retract builder declares collateral is a hypothesis that the new accounting checks will settle before any repair.

requirements-and-their-evidence.text: Each requirement is listed with the model statement or contract it rests on, its entry points and the form of evidence. A row is not covered until its receipts exist. Development-node journeys establish the lifecycle and the four refusals; confirmed public receipts follow only after the operator's decision. Each requirement is established by the first form of evidence that can establish it; a later form is not implied by an earlier one.

the-duplicated-token-carrier.text: The duplicated carrier case of the update statement stays a non-live case with its model and validator tests and its conditional argument. It is distinct from the same-key duplicate insertion and the post-Terminal insertion, which are required and run against the registry.
